segments.text: Narnia, level nine — the last one.
There is no exploit here: logging in as narnia nine just shows the completion file.
I log in as narnia nine.
The home directory holds a file called CONGRATULATIONS, and it reads: you are l three three t, next please — with a note asking us not to post writeups or spoilers. The game is complete.
The password for narnia nine is shown, and the game is complete.
